title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin closes the US session at $63,143, down 1.2% as Extreme Fear locks in at 20 on the index. Price action stayed range-bound with no decisive break, leaving bulls defending the $62,800 zone into the close.

Network fundamentals hold steady. Hashrate sits at 938.5 EH/s while the mempool backs up to 90,588 transactions, keeping the fastest fee at just 3 sat/vB.

Key takeaway: selling pressure remains light despite the fear reading, and miner security shows no signs of stress.
